'''Copper Ore''' is obtained from [[Mining#Copper Node|Copper Nodes]] with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]]. Mining a copper node will yield between 1 and 3 copper ore. The [[Skills#Mining|Miner Profession]] can further increase this.

==Locations==
* Can be bought at the [[Blacksmith]] for {{Price|75}} each in Year 1 and for {{Price|150}} each in Year 2+
* Mining [[Mining#Copper Node|Copper Nodes]].
** [[The Mines]] (Floors 2-39)<ref name="copperfloors" /> have a high concentration of [[Mining#Copper Node|Copper Nodes]], relative to other floors. The surrounding regular rocks also have a high probability of dropping a single copper ore.
** Copper Nodes can spawn in the [[Quarry]], the [[Quarry Mine]], or in the quarry on the [[Farm Maps#Hilltop|Hill-top]] and [[Farm Maps#Four Corners|Four Corners]] Farm Maps.
** Copper Nodes can be found on any floor of the [[Skull Cavern]] and [[Volcano Dungeon]].
* Can be found in breakable crates and barrels in [[the Mines]].
* Can be found by [[Hoes|tilling]] soil in [[the Mines]].
* Can be dropped by [[Metal Head]]s on floors 80-119 of [[the Mines]].
* Can be dropped by [[Slimes|Copper Slimes]] in the [[Quarry Mine]] or random [[The Mines#Dungeon Floors|dungeon floors]] in the Mines.
* Can be found inside any of the 4 types of [[Minerals#Geodes|Geode]].
* Can be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]].
* Can be found in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the [[Blacksmith]].
* Can be found by [[Pans|panning]].
* Can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] (at [[Pelican Town]], [[Railroad]], [[Bus Stop]], [[Backwoods]], [[Cindersap Forest]], or [[the Mountain]]s)
* Occasionally sold by the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|5}}.
* A [[Stonefish]] [[Fish Pond]] may produce 5 Copper Ore when the population reaches 3.
* Can be purchased from [[Clint]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|2|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each.

==Smelting==
Copper ore can be smelted in a [[Furnace]] to create a [[Copper Bar]]. The smelting requires 5 copper ore and 1 [[coal]] to begin and takes 30 in-game minutes to complete.

==Tailoring==
Copper Ore can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Turtleneck Sweater]]. [[File:Shirt178.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*The morning after collecting 1 Copper Ore, [[Clint]] will visit you and give you the blueprints for crafting a [[Furnace]]. This creates the [[Quests#Forging Ahead|"Forging Ahead" quest]].
*[[Clint]] may ask you to collect various numbers of Copper Ore in random [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|Gathering Quests]] at the "Help Wanted" board outside [[Pierre's General Store]].
*10 Copper Ore are requested by [[Stonefish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 1 to 3.
